definitions.explanation: Evidence or documentation that establishes the truth of something.

examples.japanese: {身分|みぶん}{証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ}を{見|み}せてください。
{彼|かれ}の{無罪|むざい}を{証明|しょうめい}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to prove his innocence.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}が{彼|かれ}がそこにいた{証明|しょうめい}になる。
examples.english: This photo is proof that he was there.

notes:
{証明|しょうめい}する is commonly used as a する-verb meaning "to prove" or "to certify."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ} (certificate, proof document)
- {身分|みぶん}{証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ} (ID card)
- {卒業|そつぎょう}{証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ} (graduation certificate)
- {在籍|ざいせき}{証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ} (certificate of enrollment)
- {証明|しょうめい}を{求|もと}める (to demand proof)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
{証明|しょうめい} (proof) vs {照明|しょうめい} (lighting) - same reading, different meaning.
